questions.text: Who is the only recipient of the 'Hilal-e-Kashmir', an award equivalent to Nishan-e-Haider?
questions.explanation: Naik Saif Ali Janjua is the only recipient of the Hilal-e-Kashmir, an award considered equivalent to the Nishan-e-Haider. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/kashmir-conflict) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: What did the Karachi Agreement establish in Kashmir?
questions.explanation: The Karachi Agreement of 1949 established the cease-fire line in Kashmir, which later came to be known as the Line of Control (LoC) after the Simla Agreement of 1972. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/kashmir-conflict) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: According to 1941 Census of the population of Kashmir state was Muslim.
questions.explanation: According to the 1941 Census, 77% of the population of Kashmir state was Muslim. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/kashmir-conflict) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: In which year was the Ceasefire Line in Kashmir drawn?
questions.explanation: The Ceasefire Line in Kashmir was drawn in 1949 following the UN-brokered ceasefire between India and Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/kashmir-conflict) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Maharaja Hari Singh of Kashmir signed the Instrument of Accession with India on _?
questions.explanation: Per the Indian account the Instrument of Accession was signed on 26 October 1947 (accepted by Mountbatten on 27 October); Pakistan disputes its validity. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/kashmir-conflict) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Which country took the Kashmir dispute to the United Nations?
questions.explanation: India took the Kashmir dispute to the United Nations in January 1948 under Article 35 of the UN Charter. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/kashmir-conflict) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Kashmir Independence movement started in which year?
questions.explanation: The Kashmir Independence movement started in 1931. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/kashmir-conflict) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Kashmir is a part of ?
questions.explanation: Kashmir is a disputed region that is currently divided among Pakistan, India, and China. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/kashmir-conflict) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Indian forces occupied Kashmir in the year ?
questions.explanation: Indian forces occupied Kashmir in the year 1947, shortly after the partition of the subcontinent. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/kashmir-conflict) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: North Korea, East Germany, and Cambodia were recognized during the reign of _?
questions.explanation: North Korea, East Germany, and Cambodia were recognized during the reign of Zulfikar Ali Bhutto. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/miscellaneous-foreign-policy-international-relations) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: In which year was Nelson Mandela of South Africa awarded Nishan-e-Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Nelson Mandela was awarded the Nishan-e-Pakistan in 1992. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/miscellaneous-foreign-policy-international-relations).

questions.text: What is the name given to the Pakistan-Russia military exercise?
questions.explanation: The Pakistan-Russia military exercise is named Druzhba, which means "Friendship" in Russian, so both names refer to the same exercise. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/miscellaneous-foreign-policy-international-relations).

questions.text: Pakistan test-fires Shaheen-III surface to surface ballistic missile with a strike range of up to _?
questions.explanation: Pakistan's Shaheen-III surface-to-surface ballistic missile has a strike range of up to 2,750 km. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/nuclear-program) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: In October 2023, which country conducted a successful flight test of Ababeel Missile?
questions.explanation: In October 2023, Pakistan conducted a successful flight test of the Ababeel Missile. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/nuclear-program).

questions.text: When did Pakistan celebrate the Silver Jubilee of Youm-e-Takbeer?
questions.explanation: Pakistan celebrated the Silver Jubilee (25th anniversary) of Youm-e-Takbeer on 28 May 2023. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/nuclear-program).

questions.text: The latest version of Hatf-5 is ?
questions.explanation: The latest version of Hatf-5 is Ghauri-1. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/nuclear-program).

questions.text: The Range of Missile Hatf-7 is:
questions.explanation: The range of the Hatf-7 (Babur) cruise missile is 350-700 km. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/nuclear-program).

questions.text: Which country is the biggest arms provider of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: China is the biggest arms provider of Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-china) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: In which year was the Pak-China border dispute settled?
questions.explanation: The Pak-China border dispute was settled in 1963 through a landmark boundary agreement between Pakistan and China. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-china) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Which country collaborates with Pakistan to produce the JF-17 Thunder fighter aircraft?
questions.explanation: The JF-17 Thunder is a multi-role fighter aircraft jointly developed and produced by Pakistan and China. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-china) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Which two countries established diplomatic relations on 21 May 1951?
questions.explanation: Pakistan and China established diplomatic relations on 21 May 1951. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-china) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: In the early 1970s, Pakistan played a role in rapprochement between which two countries?
questions.explanation: In the early 1970s, Pakistan played a key role in facilitating rapprochement between US and China. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-china) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: The Tashkent Pact was signed between which two countries after the 1965 war?
questions.explanation: The Tashkent Pact was signed between India and Pakistan after the 1965 war. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-india) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: According to the Tashkent Declaration, what were Pakistan and India required to do with their armed forces?

options.B: Maintain forward positions along the ceasefire line
options.D: Reduce forces by 50% on both sides

questions.explanation: Under the Tashkent Declaration of 1966, both Pakistan and India agreed to withdraw their armed forces to pre-war positions. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-india).

questions.text: Kulbushan Jadev, an Indian spy, was arrested from ?
questions.explanation: Kulbushan Jadev, an Indian spy, was arrested from Balochistan in March 2016. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-india).

questions.text: On which date was the Delhi-Lahore bus service inaugurated by Atal Bihari Vajpayee in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The Delhi-Lahore bus service, also known as Sada-e-Sarhad, was inaugurated by Indian Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee on 20th February, 1999 in Pakistan. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-india).

questions.text: The Rann of Kutch, whose maps were finalized in 1969, is shared between which two regions?
questions.explanation: The Rann of Kutch is a marshy border region shared between Gujarat (India) and Sindh (Pakistan). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-india).

questions.text: The "Treaty of Rann of Kutch" was signed between India and Pakistan in which year?
questions.explanation: The Treaty of Rann of Kutch was signed between India and Pakistan in 1965. Note: the India–Pakistan Rann of Kutch agreement was signed in June 1965; the tribunal award came in 1968. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-india).

questions.text: Who supervised the signing of the Karachi Agreement between India and Pakistan?

options.A: United Nations Commission for India and Pakistan
options.B: International Committee of the Red Cross

questions.explanation: The Karachi Agreement between India and Pakistan was supervised by the United Nations Commission for India and Pakistan (UNCIP). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-india).

questions.text: India took up the case of Kulbushan Jadhav in?
questions.explanation: India took up the case of Kulbushan Jadhav in the International Court of Justice (ICJ). Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-india).

questions.text: Who becomes first female ambassador of Pakistan to Iran?
questions.explanation: Riffat Masood became the first female ambassador of Pakistan to Iran. Low confidence: Riffat Masood became Pakistan's first female ambassador to Iran in 2018. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-islamic-countries) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Which country gifted the silver railing erected on Quaid-e-Azam's Tomb?
questions.explanation: The silver railing around Quaid-e-Azam's Tomb was gifted by Iran. Low confidence: the silver railing/grill at the Mazar-e-Quaid is commonly cited as a gift from Iran. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-islamic-countries).

questions.text: Who participated from Pakistan in the First Islamic Conference?
questions.explanation: General Yahya Khan represented Pakistan at the First Islamic Conference (First Islamic Summit) held in Rabat, Morocco in 1969. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-islamic-countries) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Which two countries signed an agreement on a Joint rapid reaction force on 03 April 2019?
questions.explanation: On 03 April 2019, Pakistan and Iran signed an agreement to establish a Joint Rapid Reaction Force aimed at enhancing border security cooperation. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-islamic-countries) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: What was the main reason for Pakistan's decision to leave SEATO?

options.D: Failure to provide assistance against India

questions.explanation: Pakistan left SEATO primarily due to the alliance's failure to provide assistance against India during the 1965 and 1971 wars. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-usa) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Which missile was given to Pakistan during the Afghan War?
questions.explanation: The Stinger missile was provided to Pakistan by the United States during the Afghan War (Soviet-Afghan War) to support the Mujahideen against Soviet forces. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-usa) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Kargil Issue was the main cause of war between India and Pakistan in 1999 and the war was stopped by intervention of:
questions.explanation: The Kargil War of 1999 was stopped by the intervention of USA, when President Bill Clinton facilitated Pakistan's withdrawal from the Kargil heights. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-usa) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Sherry Rehman has served Pakistan's ambassador to which country?
questions.explanation: Sherry Rehman served as Pakistan's ambassador to the USA from 2011 to 2013. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-usa) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Kerry Lugar Bill authorized non-military aid to Pakistan for a period of _?
questions.explanation: The Kerry Lugar Bill authorized non-military aid to Pakistan for a period of 2010-2014. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-usa) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Who was Pakistan's first ambassador to the United States?
questions.explanation: Pakistan's first ambassador to the United States was Abdul Hassan Isphani. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/relations-with-usa) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Where was the Second Islamic Summit Conference held?
questions.explanation: The Second Islamic Summit Conference was held in Lahore, Pakistan, in 1974. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/united-nations-oic-membership) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: Which Session of UNO did Imran Khan deliver a historic speech in?
questions.explanation: Imran Khan delivered his historic speech at the 74th Session of the UN General Assembly in 2019. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/united-nations-oic-membership) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.

questions.text: In April 2017, Nobel Laureate Pakistani Malala Yousaf Zai was designated as ?
questions.explanation: In April 2017, Nobel Laureate Malala Yousaf Zai was designated as UN Messenger of Peace, becoming the youngest ever to receive this honor. Source: pakjobmcqs.com (https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies/chapters/united-nations-oic-membership) — marked as a past-paper MCQ there.
